Calendar invite to follow.

1) Run a 30-min focused session on Tue at 09:00–09:30 PT with Soojin (covers latency + integrations). I'll record and provide a short follow-up summary + a 1:1 deep-dive after my other commitment.

2) Keep the original 60-min block but move it to Wed 09:30–10:30 PT when both Soojin and I are available in full.

Marissa — any preference? Priya/Ethan — do either of these work for your team? If you're tight on stakeholder availability, option 1 is my recommendation to keep timelines.
